key_impacts: Residential structures in Mountain Shadows were damaged and destroyed.
First responders conducted defensive actions to prevent ignitions and extinguish damaged structures.
Multiple nearby communities, including Cedar Heights and Peregrine to Wolfe Ranch, were affected.
evidence_snippets: Title: A Case Study of a Community Affected by the Waldo Fire – Event Timeline and Defensive Actions.
